newsitem.title: UK: Hillsdown says profits ahead of same last yr.
newsitem.headline: Hillsdown says profits ahead of same last yr.

text.p: Diversified British food group Hillsdown Holdings Plc said on Friday its profits were "running ahead of the comparable period last year".

"Much could change in the political and economic climate before the final quarter of this year, which is when we make the greater proportion of our profits," chairman Sir John Nott told the annual general meeting. "But, subject to this qualification, I am hopeful that a useful start to the year will carry through into a successful 1997."

He said that with 16 percent of the group's profits coming from the continent, the sterling value of these profits has been adversely affected this year. However, substantial imports of raw material from the continent helps offset the translation costs.
"Generally, we are hopeful that currency fluctuations need not have any material adverse effects on our profits," Nott said in a statement.
